title: Objects Recognition
shortDescription: Identify real-world objects instantly and unlock digital content, actions, or stories in response. A seamless bridge between tangible interaction and smart digital experiences.
longDescription: Recognise physical items in real time using RFID, NFC, vision, or sensors to trigger tailored digital reactions. From product storytelling and playful gamification to guided learning or dynamic displays, this creates intuitive, hands-on moments that feel natural and magical. Ideal for exhibitions, retail, museums, and brand activations where physical presence meets digital intelligence. BRDGE handles the recognition logic, content mapping, scene management, and the links to journey, gallery, and data outputs.

highlights.title: Many Ways to Recognize
highlights.description: Recognize objects the way that suits the space: a QR scan, an NFC or RFID tap, or camera vision that spots the item on sight. One system supports several methods, so the same setup works for a printed tag, a wristband, a product, or a bare artifact.

highlights.title: Any Object Becomes a Trigger
highlights.description: Turn products, artifacts, props, or tokens into interactive touchpoints. A visitor simply shows or taps the thing in their hand and the screen responds, a hands-on moment that feels natural and a little magical, with no app and nothing to learn.

highlights.title: Fits Almost Any Venue
highlights.description: The same technology drops into a retail shelf, a museum exhibit, a trade-show booth, or a brand activation, and points at product marketing, education, or play. That breadth makes it easy to pitch to very different clients from one core setup.

highlights.title: Scan-to-Collect & Combos
highlights.description: Add a scan-them-all collectible challenge, unlock bonus content when two objects are combined, layer an AR overlay onto the recognized item, or serve a different reaction per visitor profile. New recognition methods and props slot in as paid upgrades.

highlights.title: From Product Story to Treasure Hunt
highlights.description: Reskin the same recognition engine as a product-story reveal, a museum discovery trail, a retail try-me display, a branded treasure hunt, or a festive edition. The look and story change while the trigger stays exactly the same.

highlights.title: Optional Scan Data
highlights.description: Add a data layer to log which objects were recognized, how often, dwell time per item, and the paths visitors take, then export it for a post-event read on what actually drew attention.

highlights.title: Wire It Into the Journey
highlights.description: Pair it with Visitor Identificator to tailor reactions to each visitor, with Journey Manager to make every object one stop on a route, with Trail / Scavenger Hunt to turn scanning into a game, or with a Shared Gallery to collect the moments it unlocks.

states.trigger: No object detected in the zone.
states.experience: A looping prompt invites visitors to scan, tap, or hold up an object to see what it unlocks.
states.feedback: Idle visuals, a clear how-to cue, ambient sound.
states.configurable: Attract visuals, branding, demo object set, prompt copy.
states.data: Footfall near the zone, attract-to-scan conversion.

states.trigger: A visitor scans, taps, or presents a recognized object.
states.experience: The system identifies the item and confirms the match before revealing its content.
states.feedback: Recognition animation, item name, a confirming sound.
states.configurable: Recognition method, matched object set, confirmation style.
states.data: Objects recognized, recognition method used, misreads.

states.experience: The screen plays the content tied to that object: a story, a fact, a game, a reward, or a dynamic display.
states.feedback: Tailored visuals, audio, or animation for the matched item.
states.configurable: Content per object, reaction type, depth, language.
states.data: Reactions played, dwell time per object, completion.

states.trigger: The reaction ends or the visitor presents another object.
states.experience: Visitors can scan the next object, dig deeper, or follow a prompt into a wider journey.
states.feedback: Next-object prompt, related content, optional route cue.
states.configurable: Follow-on content, journey hand-off, call to action.
states.data: Objects per session, repeat scans, journey hand-offs.

states.trigger: The object is removed or the session times out.
states.experience: The zone clears and returns to the attract loop for the next visitor.
states.feedback: Brief thanks, then a fade back to attract.
states.configurable: Timeout duration, end-screen call to action.
